Two temporary visitors to Belgrave, American Olympic athletes Goertz Klopfer and Tom Dooley, have made many friends as well as producing some really great performances - its as well for the other clubs that they are not staying longer !

In the second lap Nihill and Sutherland pulled away leaving Tom Dooley USA and Belgrave some thirty seconds down in third place. Carl Lawton has really shaken off his recent lack of form and he finished fifth close on Wil Wesch's heels.

In a 3,000 metres walk at Crystal Palace on October 25th WIL WESCH led American Olympian Ron Laird to the half distance before conceding victory 13:01.0 to 13:14.2. JOHN KNIFTON continues to show fine form in U.S.A. where he recently finished 3rd in the National 30 Kilos behind Ron Laird and Tom Dooley.
